person.name: Abu Huraira
person.tagline: Specializing in Web Development, AI Automation, and Software Development to build intuitive, high-performance digital solutions.

paragraphs: I am Abu Huraira, a dedicated Full-Stack Web Developer, Software Developer, Application Developer, and AI Automation Expert. With a passion for building robust digital products, I bridge creative frontend design with resilient engineering—delivering high-performance web platforms, intuitive mobile/cross-platform applications, and robust software architectures that scale effortlessly.

Beyond standard development, I specialize in next-generation AI Automation. I engineer intelligent workflows, autonomous multi-agent pipelines, and custom API automations that streamline complex business operations, eliminate redundant manual tasks, and unlock exponential productivity for modern businesses.

focus.title: Full-Stack Web Development
focus.text: Engineering end-to-end, ultra-fast web platforms using Next.js, React, Node.js, and TypeScript. From responsive, accessible user interfaces to robust database architecture and secure REST/GraphQL APIs.

focus.title: Software Development
focus.text: Building scalable, maintainable, and type-safe software solutions with clean architecture principles, modular services, deterministic test coverage, and enterprise-grade reliability.

focus.title: Application Development
focus.text: Crafting intuitive, cross-platform applications featuring fluid UI interactions, offline capabilities, state management, and seamless performance across desktop, web, and mobile environments.

focus.title: AI Automation Expert
focus.text: Developing autonomous AI agents, LLM-powered business automations, intelligent data processing pipelines, and smart bot integrations to eliminate repetitive workflows and boost business efficiency.

projects.title: Madrasa Management System
projects.summary: A comprehensive full-stack management web portal designed for madrasas to streamline student admissions, attendance, fee collection, and academic records.
projects.problem: Manual paper-based record keeping, delayed fee collection tracking, lack of centralized student databases, and time-consuming report card generation.
projects.solution: Engineered an automated web application featuring role-based dashboards, automated student billing and fee receipts, digital attendance, and instant grade sheet generation.

experience.summary: Spearheading infrastructure modernization, Kubernetes cluster governance, and core API resilience across 14 cross-functional microservices.
Architected distributed caching layers and optimized transactional PostgreSQL queries, cutting p95 response times by 40% across tier-1 endpoints.
Delivered responsive, accessible Next.js web applications and integrated secure RESTful APIs with automated CI/CD pipeline automation.
Authored and maintain developer tooling for TypeScript AST analysis, schema migrations, and high-performance HTTP middleware.
